dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, luminous perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from the dark exterior pelt to bright, thin boundaries. The central-most rings show a distinct decrease in pixel intensity towards their internal centers compared to their perimeter brightness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid-fill high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily in the upper-midsection. A high concentration of smaller, low-intensity pixel blobs is visible in the posterior (left-hand) region, forming a densely packed, fragmented texture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular, elongated pentagonal polygon. The geometric relationship between the largest central 'O' structure and the adjacent superior blobs defines a series of obtuse angles forming a primary horizontal axis across the mid-lateral field.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique, bifurcated 'heart-shaped' closed loop is present in the upper-right quadrant of the lateral texture field.
